## The wordmark

|  | Eyebrow | Name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arabic | رابطة شباب التاكلالت | **كأس العمدة** |
| French | Association des Jeunes de Taguilalett | **Coupe du maire** |

Set in **Tajawal** for Arabic and **Tajawal** for French, and outlined to paths in every generated file — so a print shop without the font still gets the right letterforms. The wordmark is never retyped by hand and never set in another face. If it has to change, change `brand/entities.yml` and rebuild.

## Lockups

### `badge`

The committee and event pattern. Social avatars, jerseys, stickers, event signage.

### `vertical`

Cover pages, posters, roll-ups — anywhere with height to spare.

### `horizontal`

Letterheads, website headers, email signatures, banners. The default in any space wider than it is tall.

### `symbol`

Coupe du maire de Taguilalett's own artwork — `logos/src/marks/mayor-cup.svg`, not the association's mosque. An event runs for one season and is allowed a mark of its own; what keeps it in the family is the palette, which is drawn from the same mint and copper as everything else. Profile pictures, favicons, a stamp on a photograph.

## Colour variants

- **`color`** — The default. Use it wherever colour is available.
- **`grayscale`** — One-colour printing that still reproduces tone: photocopies, newsprint, fax.
- **`mono-dark`** — A single ink on a light ground: stamps, engraving, embroidery, silk-screen.
- **`mono-light`** — Knocked out of a dark or photographic ground. Never place it on a light one.

This mark's accent is `saffron`: base `#c08a1e`, soft `#f6ead0`, deep `#835d10`. The accent is the only thing that distinguishes this mark from its siblings — the symbol, the geometry and the typography are shared on purpose, so the family reads as one organisation.

## Clear space

Leave at least **25% of the symbol's diameter** empty on every side. Nothing enters it: no text, no image, no page edge, no second logo. The generated files already carry this margin, so a file placed flush against something still keeps the correct gap.

## Minimum size

| | Print | Screen |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Badge | 18 mm | 64 px |
| Horizontal lockup | 32 mm | 120 px |

Below these the arch fills in and the wordmark stops resolving. The build refuses to emit a raster under the screen minimum — if a size you expected is missing from `logos/dist/events/mayor-cup-2026/`, that is why.

## Files

- **SVG** (28) — anything digital, and anything going to a print shop. Vector, and no font needs to be installed.
- **PNG** (84) — transparent, at each size this mark is cleared for.
- **PDF** (21) — hand these to a printer or an embroiderer.

## Using the mark

**Take a file, do not rebuild one.** Everything in `logos/dist/` is generated
and correct. Redrawing a mark in a design tool, retyping a wordmark, or
exporting a screenshot of one produces something that is nearly right, and
nearly right is how a visual identity dissolves.

**Choose the file, not the crop.** Every lockup is a separate file. Cropping the
horizontal lockup to get a symbol gives the wrong clear space; use the symbol
file.

**Prefer SVG.** It is sharp at any size and it is what a printer wants. Reach
for PNG only where SVG is not accepted.

## What not to do

- Do not change the colours. Four variants are generated; one of them fits.
- Do not stretch, squash, rotate or skew the mark. Scale it proportionally.
- Do not add effects — no shadow, glow, outline, bevel or gradient.
- Do not place the colour or `mono-dark` variant on a dark or busy ground. That
  is what `mono-light` is for.
- Do not put the mark on a background that is close to mint or copper in tone;
  it stops separating from the page.
- Do not re-typeset the wordmark, translate it, or set it in another face.
- Do not enclose the mark in a box, badge or circle of your own. The roundel and
  badge lockups already do this, correctly.
- Do not pair the mark with another logo inside its clear space. Give both room.

## Photographs

Use `mono-light` on a photograph, placed over an area that is dark and quiet.
If no such area exists, lay a dark scrim over the corner first. A mark that
competes with a busy image loses, every time.

## Getting it changed

Nothing in `logos/dist/` is edited. If a mark is wrong, the fix is in
`brand/entities.yml`, `logos/src/symbol.svg` or the token files — change one of
those, run `npm run build`, and every affected file is regenerated together.

Questions go to the Comité de communication — اللجنة الإعلامية.
